name: ChatByUser
doc: Reverse lookup of chat membership; mirrors the CQL chats_by_user table

fields.name: user_id
fields.doc: The member's user id (partition key in CQL)

fields.name: chat_id
fields.doc: The chat this user belongs to (clustering key in CQL)

fields.name: joined_at
fields.doc: When the user joined the chat (UTC epoch millis)

fields.name: authenticator
fields.doc: SSO mechanism that authenticated this member, e.g. 'openid', 'oidc', 'saml', 'google-oauth2'. Names a third-party single sign-on scheme, not a local password

fields.name: principal
fields.doc: External login identifier asserted by the authenticator, e.g. 'alice.nguyen' or 'bmartinez@example.com'. Human-meaningful, NOT a UUID; user_id remains the key for joins
